To

Subject: - Analysis of Court cases where adverse orders have been passed-
observation of EC, CBT (EPF) Regarding

Reference:- This office circular of even number dated 23.12.2014, 08.01.2015
and 28.01.2015 and 03.02.2015
Sir,

Please refer to the above mentioned office circulars of even number on the
subject cited.
2, During the discussions held in the 81% meeting of Executive Committee, CBT
(EPF) held on 18.02.2015, it has been decided that a Committee comprising of ACC (Zone),
RPFC-IL/OIC and RPFC/APFC(Legal) of the Region wil! examine the reasons of losing the ten
biggest cases ( in terms of amount) up to the level of High Court. The committee will forward its
Report to Head office to ACC (HQ) Rajesh Bansal for placing before the next Executive
Committee meeting every month.
3. Similarly the ten biggest cases { in terms of amount) lost in Supreme Court shall
be examined by the Committee of ACC (Compliance), ACC (Legal) and RPFC (Lega!) at Head
Office.
4, Accordingly, it is advised to constitute the committee for the offices under your
jurisdiction immediately and inform this office. The first such report in respect of the cases
lost in the month of January, 2015 and February, 2015 may be submitted by 10" of March,
2015 and thereafter by the 10" working day of every month,

Yours faithfully,

NS FR ys

(Rajesh Bansal)
Addl. Central P. F. Commissioner (HQ)
